title: vtc-00: rejoin via create underspecified
description: draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md:921 reuses the existing record on re-join via create but does not say what created returns or whether kickedBy clears. A create that returns an existing record breaks RFC 8620 /set semantics. Fix: rejoin by updating leftAt to null; create on an existing record returns alreadyExists.
close_reason: Rejoin is an update setting leftAt to null; create on existing record -> alreadyExists; kickedBy cleared.
